job.title: Production Supervisor - Precast Concrete
job.description:
About The Company
Our client is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer with over 50 years' history in the design, fabrication, and supply of industrial products used across Australia and internationally. With in-house manufacturing capabilities spanning precast concrete and composite production, the business maintains full control from design through to delivery, a key differentiator in a competitive market.
 
About The Role
We're looking for an experienced Production Supervisor to help lead day-to-day operations at a manufacturing facility near Parramatta. You'll take ownership of production output, safety, quality, and people performance on site. 
 
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Leading and developing the site's production team, including direct oversight of the frontline workforce, to ensure consistent output against production schedules and quality benchmarks.
  • Owning site safety performance, embedding a strong safety culture, ensuring WHS compliance, and driving toward zero-harm outcomes.
  • Managing day-to-day production planning and scheduling, ensuring on-time delivery against customer and project timelines.
  • Maintaining quality control standards in line with certified manufacturing processes and product warranty commitments.
  • Managing rostering, resourcing, and performance management across the team, including coaching and developing the staff.
  • Coordinating with procurement, logistics, and warehousing to maintain stock control and ensure materials are available to meet production demand.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives across plant efficiency, waste reduction, and process standardisation.
  • Reporting to senior leadership on site performance, capacity planning, and operational risk.
 
About You
You're an experienced manufacturing or production leader who's comfortable being hands-on and knows how to get the best out of a team. You bring genuine credibility on the plant floor and a practical understanding of what it takes to run a site well.
 
You'll likely have:
  • A proven track record in a Site Manager/Supervisor, Production Manager/Supervisor, or Operations Manager role within a manufacturing, fabrication, or industrial production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams of a similar size (10+)
  • Strong experience within precast concrete manufacturing or a closely related manufacturing or construction environment.
  • A strong working knowledge of WHS compliance and a genuine commitment to safety leadership.
  • Proven experience leading and developing production teams.
  • Strong production planning and scheduling capability.
  • Experience managing labour, resources and competing production priorities.
  • Solid understanding of production planning, scheduling, and quality control processes in a manufacturing setting.
  • Strong communication and people leadership skills, with the ability to coach, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a practical, straightforward way.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the confidence to identify and implement process efficiencies.

job.title: Store Manager - WHV's welcomed to apply!
job.description:
About The Company
Lead the flagship. Shape the experience. Get paid for performance. An Australian-founded luxury lifestyle brand, loved by women worldwide and stocked by some of the most prestigious retailers across Australia, the US and the UK, is opening its newest and largest store yet, and we're looking for the leader to make it a standout.
 
This is a brand built on beautiful natural fibres, timeless design and genuinely warm service. Now they need a Store Manager who can bring that to life on the floor every single day.
 
The role
You'll lead from the front: selling, styling and inspiring a high-performing team through your own example. You'll own the store's results, from sales and profitability to visual presentation, inventory and KPIs, and work closely with leadership to shape how the brand shows up in its biggest retail space to date.
 
What you'll bring
✦ 3+ years' management experience in fashion retail, with a proven record of hitting targets
✦ A natural stylist's eye and the ability to sell the story, feel and lifestyle behind the product
✦ Strong commercial and operational grip: budgets, VM, stock and KPIs
✦ A genuine coaching style that builds confident, motivated, customer-obsessed teams
✦ A passion for elevated, luxury customer experiences
 
What's in it for you
✦ Attractive Salary package + up to 30% monthly performance bonus
✦ Launch and lead a flagship store for a fast-growing global brand
✦ Small, close-knit team where your impact is visible and valued
✦ A people-first culture built on balance, flexibility and trust
✦ Generous staff product allowance
 
If you're a floor-first leader who loves luxury, loves people and loves winning, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: CRM & Marketing Specialist (Klaviyo)
job.description:
The opportunity
 
Our client is an iconic Australian luxury fashion house with a loyal, global community, selling through its own online storefronts, boutiques and wholesale partners. They're moving from calendar-led broadcasting to communications shaped by what each customer actually wants, and this role sits at the centre of that shift.
 
As the day-to-day owner of Klaviyo, you'll build, fix and scale the automated email and SMS journeys that turn first-time buyers into repeat customers and bring lapsed customers back, working closely with the data, ecommerce, retail and clienteling teams.
 
What you'll do
  • Own and optimise core flows: welcome, browse and cart abandon, back-in-stock, post-purchase, win-back and VIP
  • Design journeys for the moments that matter most, especially converting first-time buyers into second purchases
  • Build cross-flow logic properly, including frequency caps, suppression rules and exit/re-entry conditions
  • Create behavioural segments and use dynamic content and product feeds so every send feels personal
  • Run a structured testing programme across subject lines, creative, timing, offers and journeys
  • Report on revenue, conversion, repeat purchase rate and retention, not just opens and clicks
  • Own QA and compliance (Spam Act, Privacy Act and international equivalents), and keep the account healthy with clean data and documented logic
  • Keep every email and SMS unmistakably on-brand, from tone to design
About you
  • 5+ years in email, CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation, ideally in fashion, luxury, beauty or DTC ecommerce
  • Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including complex flows, segments and dynamic content (essential)
  • Experience connecting Shopify and retail data into an ESP
  • A track record of lifting retention, repeat purchase or lifetime value
  • Analytical confidence and the ability to turn data into action
  • A genuine eye for design and brand, and an understanding of why tone matters in luxury
  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple journeys at once
  • Nice to have: CDP, clienteling or omnichannel retail data experience, multi-market programmes, basic HTML/CSS, SQL

job.title: Production Manager
job.description:
About the opportunity

Our client is a well-established, family-owned Australian fresh produce business with more than 50 years of experience and four generations of hands-on expertise. They grow quality product on trusted NSW farms and supply it through to major supermarkets, and they take real pride in continuous improvement.

They're now looking for an experienced Production Manager to step in for an initial 8-week engagement, keep operations running smoothly and make an immediate impact. For the right person, this is a genuine opportunity to move into a permanent role.

The role
  • Lead and coordinate daily production, packing and dispatch operations
  • Manage, motivate and roster production teams to meet volume and quality targets
  • Plan production schedules to meet customer and retail supply demands
  • Drive a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with WHS and food safety standards
  • Monitor KPIs including yield, wastage, efficiency and labour cost, and act on what the numbers tell you
  • Identify and implement practical process improvements
  • Work closely with the growing, quality, logistics and commercial teams
About you
  • Proven experience as a Production Manager or Operations Manager in food manufacturing, fresh produce, agriculture or a similar fast-paced FMCG environment
  • Strong people leadership, with the ability to earn the respect of a hands-on, shop-floor team
  • Working knowledge of food safety and quality systems (HACCP, SQF or equivalent)
  • Comfortable making decisions quickly and getting stuck in when needed
  • Commercially minded, with a good eye for efficiency and continuous improvement
  • Available to start immediately, or on short notice
  • Right to work in Australia

job.title: Technical Business Analyst (AI-Enabled)
job.description:
About The Company
 
Our client is a high growth, private equity backed business operating in the renewable energy storage sector, one of the most active and important spaces in the current energy transition. Growth has been rapid, and the commercial side of the business is performing well.
 
This is a business that genuinely embraces modern tools, including AI-assisted development, and expects its people to work the same way.
 
About The Role
 
This is a hands-on Technical Business Analyst role for someone who wants to fix problems, not just document them. You'll work across sales, operations, installers and finance to map workflows end to end, identify where processes break down, and then build the solution yourself using AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor to turn findings into working systems rather than static requirements documents.
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Mapping and improving cross-functional workflows, identifying manual steps, double handling and data gaps
  • Owning the data layer, writing and optimising SQL in BigQuery, modelling data from source systems, reconciling records, and building reporting/dashboards
  • Specifying and building integrations between platforms such as Cin7, HubSpot and other operational systems (API mapping, data rules, error handling, monitoring)
  • Automating repetitive work through scheduled jobs, triggered workflows or AI agents
  • Building and extending React front ends for internal tools (CRM views, scheduling, installer workflows, ticketing)
  • Running delivery, writing PRDs, prioritising the backlog, running UAT, and taking changes through to go-live
  • Keeping data definitions, integration specs and process maps current
About You
  • 5+ years' experience as a technical BA, systems analyst or product analyst in a delivery-heavy environment
  • Strong SQL skills, ideally with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse (joins, CTEs, window functions, data quality checks)
  • Integration experience with REST APIs, webhooks and JSON, and hands-on exposure to platforms like HubSpot, Cin7, Unleashed or Xero
  • Comfortable reading, editing and shipping React/JavaScript/TypeScript front-end code, with AI tools accelerating the work
  • Genuine, demonstrable experience with AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar),  you know how to review and test the output, not just accept it
  • A process-improvement mindset and the confidence to work directly with frontline teams to turn messy workflows into clear future states
  • A bias toward shipping working fixes over handing over specs
  • Python for scripting and data pipelines
  • Exposure to MCP, LLM agents or workflow tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier
  • Google Cloud experience beyond BigQuery (e.g. Cloud Functions, Scheduler)

job.title: Customer Service Consultant - Sydney CBD | Sponsorship Available
job.description:
About the Company 

Join one of Australia's most exciting start-ups as they reshape personal lending with empathy, speed and a customer-first mindset. Backed by rapid growth and purpose, they've significantly grown the past few years. 

We're on the lookout for full-time Customer Service Consultants to join the team in their Sydney CBD office. This is more than a job - it's a chance to make a real difference to everyday Australians who need support navigating life's trickier moments.

What you'll be doing:
  • Handle inbound customer enquiries via phone and email
  • Help customers through their loan application journey with care and clarity
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams to progress applications
  • Provide timely updates and solve problems with a sense of urgency
  • Bring empathy, warmth and active listening to every interaction
  • Keep things moving - follow up with clients and partners to stay on track
What we're looking for:
  • Clear, confident communicator with outstanding listening skills
  • Empathetic and solutions-focused - you genuinely care about helping people
  • Resilient and adaptable in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Tech-savvy, accurate and confident juggling multiple systems
  • Contact centre experience is a big plus, but not essential
  • Full working rights or on a Working Holiday Visa? No worries - you're welcome to apply
  • Sponsorship is available for the right candidates
What's in it for you:
  • Full-time, Sydney CBD office-based role (no remote)
  • Career growth and learning opportunities in a booming sector
  • Competitive salary 
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Be part of a business that's genuinely making lives better

job.title: Head of Finance
job.description:
About The Company 
 
Our client is a fast growing, Australian brand with a genuine global footprint. With Australia representing around a third of the business and the remainder spread across international markets, this is a company that manufactures its own products, sells predominantly through wholesale channels, and continues to expand into new territories. Backed by venture capital, the business is in a genuine growth and change phase, and this is your opportunity to be a key part of that next stage.
 
We are seeking an experienced, hands on Head of Finance to lead the finance function and play a central role in the commercial direction of the business. 
 
About The Role 
 
You will lead a small, highly experienced finance team, take ownership of all financial reporting and analysis, and act as a genuine business partner to the leadership team on the big picture decisions shaping the company's growth. 
 
Key responsibilities include:
  • Preparing and presenting monthly board reporting to VC and investor stakeholders
  • Consolidating financial reporting across multiple business entities
  • Overseeing costing and product costing, including raw materials, cost of goods and inventory holding
  • Deliver budgeting, forecasting, reporting and commercial analysis
  • Managing multi-currency, multi-customer forecasting across a largely international customer base
  • Utilising AI tools and platforms to enhance forecasting, stock planning and reporting efficiency
  • Drive improvements across processes, controls, reporting and automation
  • Providing commercial support on supplier negotiations, capital investment and growth initiatives
About You
 
To succeed in this role you will bring proven, hands on experience in a similar consumer goods environment, ideally retail, beauty, fashion or a closely aligned industry.
  • CA/CPA qualified 
  • Prior experience in a Head of Finance, or similar senior finance role within a consumer goods, retail, beauty, fashion or manufacturing business
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and presenting board reports, ideally gained within a VC backed, private equity backed, or listed business environment
  • Strong technical accounting and reporting skills, with the ability to consolidate reporting across multiple entities
  • Direct experience with inventory builds, product costing, bills of materials and manufacturing cost structures
  • High AI literacy and comfort adopting new technology and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage in commercial discussions with international investors and stakeholders
  • The maturity and commercial acumen to operate at a senior level, balancing detail with big picture thinking
Key Benefits: 
  • This is a rare opportunity to join a genuinely exciting, homegrown Australian brand at an important stage of its growth.
  • You will work closely with an engaged and commercially minded leadership team
  • Be part of a company that is building something significant on the global stage
  • Hybrid working 
  • Attractive Salary Package + Bonus
